GAP_DEG_DEFINITION_D21.DEFINITION: gap_deg is the SIGNED SEPARATION between two groups' nearest range endpoints. It is POSITIVE and meaningful ONLY when the ranges are disjoint, where it equals min(higher group) - max(lower group). When the ranges OVERLAP the quantity is undefined and gap_deg is null, matching MATCHED20_ENDPOINT_r298.json's convention. Overlap width, where reported, is a SEPARATE field named overlap_deg and is NOT the magnitude of any negative gap_deg.
GAP_DEG_DEFINITION_D21.applied_r317: Every negative gap_deg in this file has been set to null with its former value preserved in gap_deg_SUPERSEDED_signed_difference. Positive, disjoint entries are unchanged.
GAP_DEG_DEFINITION_D21.worked_counterexample: Reading C knee formerly read gap_deg = -0.6504 while the TRUE overlap width is 0.4694 deg. The two differ, which is why the negative was never an overlap width and could not be reinterpreted as one.
GAP_DEG_DEFINITION_D21.why_not_recomputed_as_overlap: Overlap widths are not deposited for every pair in this file, and computing them here would add numbers this verification file never measured. Null is the honest value.
